summary: The National Horticultural Traders Association wants a modern member app with an unspecified AI feature, but this first exploratory call left member count, launch date, environments, integration details, compliance scope, cloud preference and budget all unconfirmed; confidence is low until these gaps are closed with the customer.

items.title: Modernise a dated member experience
items.description: The association wants a modern member experience with some AI capability, replacing a portal staff describe as dated.

source.quote: The Executive Director opened by saying "we just know our current member experience feels dated and we want something modern with some AI in it."

items.title: Member self-service demand signal
items.description: Members have emailed asking to update their own contact details directly, evidencing demand for self-service.

source.quote: The Membership Coordinator said a handful of members have emailed asking "why can't I just update my address myself" which is part of why this came up now.

items.title: Automate renewal reminders
items.description: The association wants renewal reminders to go out automatically instead of being tracked manually by the Membership Coordinator.

source.quote: They would like renewal reminders to go out automatically instead of the Membership Coordinator tracking them manually.

items.title: Member
items.description: A representative of a member business (a wholesale nursery, garden retailer or landscape supplier) who logs in, updates the business profile and renews membership.

source.quote: They want a modern member app that lets members log in, update their profile and renew their membership online.

items.title: Association Staff (Non-Technical)
items.description: The association's roughly six staff, none technical, who will need to operate and support the app after launch.

source.quote: The Executive Director said the association has about six staff in total and none of them are technical, so day-to-day support after launch would likely need to sit with the delivery partner or a future hire.

items.title: Member login, profile and online renewal
items.description: Members log in, update their profile and renew their membership online.

source.quote: They want a modern member app that lets members log in, update their profile and renew their membership online.

items.title: AI feature - concept only
items.description: An AI feature is wanted, described only loosely as possibly a member-question chatbot or a newsletter-writing aid.

source.quote: They want some kind of AI feature but were not specific; the Executive Director said "maybe a chatbot that can answer member questions, or something that helps us write newsletters, we are open to ideas."

items.title: Improved member directory search
items.description: Members should be able to search the directory of other members more easily than the current experience allows.

source.quote: The Membership Coordinator would like members to be able to search the directory of other members more easily than today.

items.title: Event registration for annual trade show (scope undecided)
items.description: Event registration for the annual trade show is wanted but not yet confirmed as part of this engagement.

source.quote: They mentioned wanting event registration for their annual trade show but were not sure if that should be part of this project or handled separately.

items.title: Automated renewal reminders
items.description: Renewal reminders should go out automatically instead of the Membership Coordinator tracking them manually.

source.quote: They would like renewal reminders to go out automatically instead of the Membership Coordinator tracking them manually.

items.title: Online dues payment
items.description: Members should be able to pay their dues online without calling the office.

source.quote: The Executive Director said the new experience "should probably let members pay their dues online without calling the office."

items.title: Chatbot scoped to basic, sourced answers
items.description: A chatbot, if built, should only answer basic questions and not fabricate information, though "basic" was not defined.

source.quote: The Executive Director said the chatbot idea "should only answer basic questions and not make anything up," but did not describe what a basic question looks like.

items.title: Board member reporting access (scope not described)
items.description: Board members may need some kind of special access to reports, but the report content was not described.

source.quote: The Executive Director mentioned they might want board members to have some kind of special access to reports, but was not able to describe what those reports would contain.

items.title: Browse members by region or trade category
items.description: Let members see other members in their region or trade category; stated as a nice-to-have.

source.quote: The Membership Coordinator said it "would be nice" if members could see other members in their region or trade category.

items.title: Existing Membership Portal (Unconfirmed Platform)
items.description: An old membership portal is in use today; even its product name is uncertain, possibly "MemberSuite," set up years ago by an office manager.

source.quote: Members currently manage their profile, pay dues and browse the member directory through an old membership portal that the Executive Director could not name precisely, only saying "it might be called MemberSuite, or something similar, our office manager set it up years ago."

items.title: Renewal Tracking Data (Spreadsheet-Based)
items.description: Renewals are currently tracked mostly by email and a shared spreadsheet rather than a system of record.

source.quote: The Membership Coordinator said renewals are currently tracked "mostly by email and a shared spreadsheet, if I am honest."

items.title: Member Profile and Contact Data
items.description: Member profile and contact data is implied by the requested login, profile-update and renewal capabilities, though its current structure is unknown.

source.quote: They want a modern member app that lets members log in, update their profile and renew their membership online.

items.title: No in-house technical staff
items.description: The association has about six staff in total and none are technical, so post-launch support will likely need to sit with the delivery partner.

source.quote: The Executive Director said the association has about six staff in total and none of them are technical, so day-to-day support after launch would likely need to sit with the delivery partner or a future hire.

items.title: Office manager input required
items.description: The office manager who originally set up the existing portal needs to join a future call before key platform questions can be answered.

source.quote: The Executive Director agreed to loop in the office manager, who set up the original membership portal, for the next call.

items.title: Finance confirmation of member count pending
items.description: The Membership Coordinator agreed to check whether finance can produce an approximate current member count before the next call.

source.quote: The Membership Coordinator agreed to check whether finance can produce an approximate current member count before the next call.

items.title: Estimate reliability risk from unknown member count
items.description: Without a confirmed member count, any effort, timeline or cost estimate carries significant uncertainty until finance validates a figure.

source.quote: Nobody on the call could say how many active members the association currently has; the Executive Director guessed "somewhere between a couple thousand and maybe five thousand, but I would need to check with finance."

items.title: Renewal-lapse pattern suggests a process gap
items.description: Members routinely let renewals lapse and are chased later, suggesting the problem may be process as much as technology.

source.quote: The association's fiscal year runs January to December and dues renewals are meant to happen annually, though the Membership Coordinator admitted "a lot of members just let it lapse and we chase them later."

items.title: Active member count unknown
items.description: Nobody on the call could confirm the current active member count, only a rough guess of two to five thousand.

source.quote: Nobody on the call could say how many active members the association currently has; the Executive Director guessed "somewhere between a couple thousand and maybe five thousand, but I would need to check with finance."

items.title: No target launch date
items.description: No target launch date was given beyond an informal "sometime next year," with no hard deadline identified.

source.quote: Nobody could say whether they have a target launch date; the Executive Director said only "sometime next year would be nice, but there is no hard deadline that I know of."

items.title: Systems to integrate with are unnamed
items.description: It is unclear which systems, if any, the new app needs to connect to beyond an unnamed dues-payment system.

source.quote: It is unclear which systems, if any, the new app would need to connect to beyond "whatever we are using for dues payments right now," which nobody on the call could name with certainty.

items.title: Environment expectations not discussed
items.description: How many environments (development, testing, production) are expected was not mentioned and was not asked about on the call.

source.quote: Nobody mentioned how many environments (development, testing, production) they would expect or currently have, and it was not asked.

items.title: Payment-card handling responsibility unclear
items.description: No compliance or data-protection requirements were mentioned, and it is unclear whether the association or a vendor handles payment card data.

source.quote: No compliance or data-protection requirements were mentioned; when asked in passing whether they handle payment card data directly, the Executive Director said "I honestly am not sure, I think our current vendor handles that part."

items.title: No cloud platform preference
items.description: No cloud platform preference was expressed; the association has no technical staff to hold one.

source.quote: Nobody expressed a cloud platform preference; the Executive Director said "we do not really have technical staff, so whatever you all think is best."

items.title: No budget range discussed
items.description: No budget range was discussed on this call; pricing was deferred to a later conversation.

source.quote: No budget range was discussed on this call; the Executive Director said pricing would be a separate conversation once they understand what is possible.

items.title: Mobile app vs. website undecided
items.description: Whether the association wants a mobile app, a responsive website, or both was left undecided.

source.quote: It is unclear whether the association wants a mobile app, a responsive website, or both.

items.title: No existing single sign-on to reuse
items.description: Nobody could say whether an existing single sign-on or shared login system should be reused, and none appears to exist today.

source.quote: Nobody could say whether any existing single sign-on or shared login system should be reused, since the association does not appear to have one today.

items.title: Existing portal API/export capability unknown
items.description: Neither attendee could confirm whether the existing membership portal has an API or any way to export its data.

source.quote: Neither attendee could say whether the existing membership portal has an API or any way to export data; the Executive Director said "I genuinely do not know, that is a good question for our office manager."

items.title: A technical/business point of contact will be identified
items.description: Assumed the association will be able to name a technical or business point of contact once scoping resumes, despite having no technical staff today.

source.quote: The Executive Director said the association has about six staff in total and none of them are technical, so day-to-day support after launch would likely need to sit with the delivery partner or a future hire.

items.title: Renewal process will be replaced, not just integrated
items.description: Assumed the current email-and-spreadsheet renewal process will be replaced by the new app rather than kept alongside it, pending confirmation.

source.quote: The Membership Coordinator said renewals are currently tracked "mostly by email and a shared spreadsheet, if I am honest."

items.title: What is the current member count and portal platform?
items.description: Confirm the actual current member count and the platform name and vendor for the existing membership system.

source.quote: Confirm the actual current member count and the platform name and vendor for the existing membership system.

items.title: Is trade-show event registration in scope?
items.description: Confirm whether event registration for the annual trade show is in scope for this engagement or a separate future project.

source.quote: Confirm whether event registration for the annual trade show is in scope for this engagement or a separate future project.

items.title: Who handles payment card data today?
items.description: Confirm whether the association directly handles payment card data or whether an existing payment vendor is fully responsible for that.

source.quote: Confirm whether the association directly handles payment card data or whether an existing payment vendor is fully responsible for that.

items.title: Is there any target date or budget range?
items.description: Confirm whether there is any target date, even an approximate one, and any budget range the association has in mind.

source.quote: Confirm whether there is any target date, even an approximate one, and any budget range the association has in mind.

items.title: Who is the technical or business point of contact?
items.description: Confirm who on the association's side, if anyone, can act as a technical or business point of contact once the project starts.

source.quote: Confirm who on the association's side, if anyone, can act as a technical or business point of contact once the project starts.

items.title: Does the existing portal expose an API or export?
items.description: Confirm whether the existing membership portal exposes any API or export mechanism that a new app could build on.

source.quote: Confirm whether the existing membership portal exposes any API or export mechanism that a new app could build on.

items.title: Which systems must the new app connect to?
items.description: Confirm which systems the app must exchange data with, starting with the dues-payment service in use today.

source.quote: It is unclear which systems, if any, the new app would need to connect to beyond "whatever we are using for dues payments right now," which nobody on the call could name with certainty.

items.title: Which environments are expected?
items.description: Confirm whether separate development, test and production environments are expected, and whether any exist today.

source.quote: Nobody mentioned how many environments (development, testing, production) they would expect or currently have, and it was not asked.

items.title: Is any hosting or cloud constraint in place?
items.description: Confirm that no existing hosting contract, vendor or data-residency rule limits the cloud platform choice.

source.quote: Nobody expressed a cloud platform preference; the Executive Director said "we do not really have technical staff, so whatever you all think is best."

items.title: Mobile app, responsive website, or both?
items.description: Confirm whether members expect an installable mobile app, a responsive website, or both.

source.quote: It is unclear whether the association wants a mobile app, a responsive website, or both.

items.title: How should members sign in?
items.description: Confirm whether members sign in with credentials held by the new app or through an identity provider the association already pays for.

source.quote: Nobody could say whether any existing single sign-on or shared login system should be reused, since the association does not appear to have one today.

items.title: What makes the current directory search hard to use?
items.description: Ask members and staff which searches fail today (by name, region, trade category) so the improved search can be specified.

source.quote: Both attendees agreed the current member directory search is frustrating but could not describe specifically what makes it hard to use.

items.title: What should the chatbot count as a basic question?
items.description: Agree example questions the chatbot may answer and the sources it may answer from, so "basic" can be tested.

source.quote: The Executive Director said the chatbot idea "should only answer basic questions and not make anything up," but did not describe what a basic question looks like.
